narration.text: [softly] You row toward a lighthouse that should be lit. [short pause] It has been dark for eleven days. [long pause] December, nineteen hundred. A steamer passing the Flannan Isles sees that the lamp is out. [long pause] Storms keep the relief boat away until the day after Christmas. [long pause] No flag. No one comes down to meet it. [long pause] [whispers] Inside, the clock has stopped. [long pause] [softly] One set of oilskins still hangs on its hook. [long pause] Three keepers lived here. All three are gone. [long pause] On the west landing, iron railings are torn and bent, high above the sea. [long pause] The official report suggested two men went down to secure the landing in the storm, and the third ran out without his coat. [long pause] A huge wave took them. They were never found. [long pause] [whispers] But no one knows what he saw from the doorway, that made him run.
